description: Self-mask for policy inference (digital_twin.sim.self_mask): the twin is rendered from the excavator's Pi camera at the runner's joint estimate and every pixel that shows the machine is blanked before preprocessing. mount = pose of the camera, frame world_home: world axes with the machine at its homed pose (hardware_map homing). pos_m is the lens centre from the mount body origin; rpy_deg is extrinsic about world x, y, z; 0 0 0 = level, looking along world -x (toward the cab), image right = world +y. The camera stays rigid on the mount body in every other pose. (frame body, or no frame: pos_m / rpy_deg in the body frame.) The lens is configs/camera.json intrinsics (fitted on the bucket1 camera; re-check for the excavator Pi).

mount_reference.image: photo of the camera on the bucket (not published)
mount_reference.method: Single-photo estimate, not a measured extrinsic calibration
mount_reference.notes: Lens beside the bucket's upper hinge on its right side, facing along the teeth (body -x). Estimated lens centre is near the hinge longitudinally, outside the scanned right wall (y minimum -0.0528 m), and near hinge height. Zero rotation retains the tooth-facing orientation; exact tilt cannot be recovered from this photo. Validate the overlay against live frames in two known joint poses.

frame_fit.image: Pi camera frame at joints_deg (not published)
frame_fit.method: Rendered silhouette fit to manually traced robot outline; single frame, not a measured calibration
